config.name: m1bt_E_C_M_H
config.declared: M1b tuned E+C+M+H vs m1_E_resB0: paired dP1 (Holm over the declared M1b contrasts); selection DESIGN §4 (dP1 > 0.005 and > 1 SE). tuned E+C 'helps' (and m1b_more is run) iff its paired fold-wise dP1 vs m1_E_resB0 > 0 with two-sided paired t p < 0.05 (DESIGN §6 'helps' = CI excludes 0; first contrast, so Holm = unadjusted). Selection is separate: DESIGN §4 rule dP1 > 0.005 and > 1 SE.
